实现 Function.prototype.call

参考答案

Function.prototype.call = function(context = window, ...args) {
  if (typeof this !== 'function') {
    throw new TypeError('Type Error');
  }
  const fn = Symbol('fn');
  context[fn] = this;

  const res = context[fn](...args);
  delete context[fn];
  return res;
}
